source: NASA Science, NASA and ESA (European Space Agency)
about: Free NASA and ESA overview pages: every Solar System body (planets, moons, dwarf planets, asteroids, comets), Universe, Sun, Earth-science and climate topics, mission pages (NASA science missions, Apollo, Gemini, Mercury, Space Shuttle STS flights, ISS expeditions, Artemis) and ESA mission and space-science background pages.
collected: science.nasa.gov and www.nasa.gov via their WordPress sitemaps (wp-sitemap.xml) and REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/topic and /wp-json/wp/v2/mission, all pages), filtered to topic/mission overview pages (news, galleries, events, solicitations, team and media pages removed); www.esa.int via its site search API (/api/search?category=mission, all 198 missions; category=background filtered to the Science directorate) and the www.esa.int/what-we-do/explore-discover-space section pages; plus the NASA Systems Engineering Handbook from the www.nasa.gov reference sitemap. Generic page titles were replaced by the page <h1> where it was more specific. Collected 2026-11-11/12.
